title: A dry summer, a dry spring or a wet winter
intro: The weather component can scale the precipitation month by month (twelve factors). Taking 30 percent of the rain from the summer or the spring, or adding 30 percent in the winter, shows which part of the year matters for yield and for leaching.

marks.d: Varied over dry summer (rain x0.7 Jun-Aug), dry spring (rain x0.7 Mar-May), wet winter (rain x1.3 Dec-Feb).
